name: md2html-api
description: Node.js SDK (fetch-based, zero deps) for the MD2HTML Markdown-to-HTML micropayment API.
author: danielbenevides-ops

scripts.test: node -e "const {MD2HTMLClient}=require('./md2html-client');const c=new MD2HTMLClient();c.health().then(r=>{if(r.status!=='ok')throw new Error('health not ok');console.log('health ok',r.version);return c.payment();}).then(r=>{if(!r.wallet_address)throw new Error('wallet missing');console.log('payment metadata ok');}).catch(e=>{console.error('FAIL',e.message);process.exit(1);});"
